coverage.details: The released helper reproduced +13 rather than +14 at modifier +7. The corrected positive difference formula, zero/penalty convention, caller contract, ordinary/charge discrimination and a 1..20 positive property pass the 12-test Sprint 23 focused gate with production compilation.
The frozen candidate passed one unfiltered Sprint source/build/package gate: 2,594/2,594 and strict standalone package validation in 181.8 seconds.

Fresh standalone RTWP native commands at Strength 24/26/28/30 produced exact 2d10 ordinary and 4d10 charged rows with +14/+16/+18/+20 Strength totals, no unrelated additive damage, one eligible first strike and ordinary aborted/later/opportunity controls.

Fresh standalone turn-based native commands passed the same four Strength rows, including real odd-modifier hits, exact action/turn ownership, ordinary controls, Power Attack comparison and critical discrimination.
Fresh highest-risk-combined RTWP execution passed all 13 selected assertions on the exact candidate bytes and restored its compatibility transaction.

Fresh RTWP and turn-based evidence separates ordinary gore, charge-only correction, native +9 Power Attack exactly once, noncritical real hits and native critical multiplication exactly once; zero and signed penalties remain once-applied.

Fresh candidate-byte native control preserved Rhinoceros +3 and Woolly Rhinoceros +5 fixed charge increments, their ordinary/later/opportunity rows and real charge damage; the unrelated bison Power Attack carrier also remained distinct.

The correction adds no identity, route, asset or serialized state and does not touch trample, Stegosaurus trip, art ownership or lifecycle seams. Their released v0.0.152 evidence remains applicable with its original provenance.
